changelog: DeskAI v2.15.0 (Build 68): Commands. Type / in the chat box and the commands pop up right above it, narrowing as you type; tap one to run it or start it. /? or /help opens the full list, grouped (Tasks, Videos & images, Memory, The agent), with clearer wording. The menu no longer lists slash commands; it has a Commands button instead. New: /retask lists your saved retasks right above the chat box; tap one (or type a few words from it) to run it again.
